chunks: Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdallah and ‘Abdallah ibn Ja‘far al-Himyari narrated from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, from Abu ‘Abdallah (عليه السلام), who said:
Ali ibn al-Husayn (عليهما السلام) passed away at the age of fifty-seven in the year ninety-five. He lived for thirty-five years after al-Husayn.

key_terms.عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ: Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (عليهما السلام), the subject of the report
key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; a reverential expression for death

ai.seo_question: When did Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (عليه السلام) pass away, and how old was he?
ai.summary: This hadith records the age and year of the passing of Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (عليهما السلام). It also situates his life historically by stating how many years he lived after Imam al-Husayn (عليه السلام), making it an important report for the biography of the Imams.

en.sarwar: 6. Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdallah and ‘Abdallah ibn Ja‘far al-Himyari have narrated from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother, Ali ibn Mahziyar from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from ibn Muskan from abu Basir from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.) passed away at the age of fifty seven in the year ninety five. He lived for thirty five years after al-Husayn (a.s.).”
